requisito: Given a list of elapsed minutes and an upper limit, returns a new list with only the valid values (from 0 up to the limit inclusive), discarding negative values and those beyond the limit.

difetti.indizio: Look at which sequence the for loop iterates over.
difetti.spiegazione: The loop iterates directly over validi while calling validi.remove(m): when an item is removed (45), later elements shift left and the immediately following item (50) is skipped.

difetti.indizio: Look at the comparison in the elif inside the loop.
difetti.spiegazione: The condition m >= limite also discards values equal to limite (such as 30), whereas the requirement treats the upper bound as inclusive.
